analytic_ceiling_of_the_E2_family.derivation: (H + Lorden's upper bound on E[R]) / E[V]_lo
analytic_ceiling_of_the_E2_family.meaning: no bound in the E2 family -- however the partition, the split points or U are chosen -- can exceed this, because it is what the family gives when E[R] is known exactly at its largest provable value

phase1_slack_ledger.note: this is the whole of C7's improvement; the residual headroom is S1's own remainder
phase1_slack_ledger.step: C4 discards the overshoot R = S_tau' - H, replacing H + E[R] by H

phase1_slack_ledger.reason: E[tau] - E[tau'] depends on how often the clipped process is pinned at 0, which is a property of the CUSUM recursion and not of the increment law alone. Bounding it needs either a numerical kernel evaluation or new operator information; both are outside C7's compute boundary. Recorded as a known, unquantified, FAVOURABLE loss -- it can only make the true Lambda_309 larger than any bound C7 reports.
phase1_slack_ledger.step: pathwise majorant: the CUSUM clipping at 0 is dropped, so tau >= tau'

phase1_slack_ledger.note: outward rounding on the 2^-320 grid; contributes below every digit reported
phase1_slack_ledger.step: E[V] replaced by a certified upper bound

phase1_slack_ledger.reason: Lambda_309 = sup over the closed cell, so ANY point in the cell gives a valid lower bound. e_lo is the best single point because E[V] is increasing in e and the bound is decreasing in E[V]. The gap sup - value(e_lo) is not accessible without operator information.
phase1_slack_ledger.step: evaluated at the single point e = e_lo rather than at sup over the cell

phase1_slack_ledger.note: bounded by f(K) = Phi(-(K+e))/Phi(-(K-e)); recovering it would change the last bound by at most 0.70%, which does not alter any verdict
phase1_slack_ledger.step: the reflected tail rho(s+e) is dropped inside psi_lo

phase1_slack_ledger.note: a 4x finer partition is worth under 0.1%; N = 64 is fixed by the gate for reviewer reproducibility -- it re-runs in ~17s against ~75s at 4N
phase1_slack_ledger.step: LP discretisation of the measure constraint at N = 64

phase2_required_improvement.exclusion_test: cell 309 is EXCLUDED iff Gamma(A0 = B, A1 = A2 = 0) >= 0, i.e. iff the certified floor B exceeds the critical A0

thresholds.meaning: survives a 5% adverse move in the critical A0
thresholds.name: ROBUST_5

phase2_required_improvement.why_C4_is_fragile: C4 published 2.5827% margin against its own frozen-clause critical A0 3.2142360226778806. C5-T's exact-weight transport raised the critical A0 to 3.266415728267196, consuming 63% of that margin and leaving 0.9440%. A further move of that size in any successor would extinguish it.

dependencies: Lorden (1970), cited but not re-proved in C7
